english.legislation: Contrary to section 3 of the Game Act 1831.

english.notes:
(i) Close seasons:
Partridge 1st February to 1st September
Pheasant 1st February to 1st October
Black game 10th December to 20th August
Black game
(Somerset/Devon
and New Forest) 10th December to 1st September
Grouse 10th December to 12th August
Bustard 1st March to 1st September
(ii) Conies are not game.
(iii) See also the associated offence wording H4442.
